senses.gloss: f. (מְחֵי), sub. נברא, bark softened by beating and stripping.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 51b:16">Ḥull. 51ᵇ</cite> <he>ת׳ לא חיישינן</he> (Ms. R. 3 a. Ar. <cite ref="V00655"><he>תמהתא</he></cite>; Ms. R. 2 <he>תִּמְחַחְתָּא</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 50); if the animal fell upon soft bark, we do not apprehend internal injury; v. <cite ref="N00106"><he>נְבָרָא</he></cite>.
